description: This Java class 'FilesController' is a Spring MVC controller that handles file-serving endpoints for a web application, including static files and product downloads, with role-based access control.

classes.name: FilesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller for serving static and product files with role-based access control.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to serve static files from a merchant-specific repository, returning file bytes or error if not found.

methods.name: downloadProduct
methods.description: Allows users with 'PRODUCTS' role to download product digital files with appropriate headers and error handling.
